title: Yes, That's Why I Am Too

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Always, always.
...The one who has stayed by my side ever since I was so very little.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uuugh... I hate the rain... *sniffle*...!
choice_data_list: Buena, found you! ...Come on, let's go home together.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Big bro! Whoa... you're soaked...!?
Are you okay? Did you... search all over for me...?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Big sis! Whoa... you're soaked...!?
Are you okay? Did you... search all over for me...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Clutching an umbrella meant for me, getting completely drenched in the rain.
Yet still, always coming for me whenever I was being a crybaby and clinging for help.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...So, there's a race next month for kids in the lower grades of elementary school.
What do you think, dear? ...Would you like to enter?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna try... I wanna run!
And then—... Hey, Mom?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
If I ask him to come, will my big bro show up?
I wonder if he'll... come watch me run again.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
If I ask her to come, will my big sis show up?
I wonder if she'll... come watch me run again.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
(Will he watch, and make his eyes shine
all bright and sparkly just like the other day?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
With those eyes gazing straight at me, glowing with that sparkle.
The one who always gave my legs the power to feel invincible.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Someday, we're definitely gonna—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. We will...!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. We will...!!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: “Someday, without fail, we'll reach a breathtaking sight like this.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. The person I made that truly, truly precious promise with.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Phew, alright...! That should do it
for the warm-up, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And today, we're focusing mostly on
training on the woodchip track... correct?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's start with a 1,000-meter run.
Yeah. Let's start with a 1,000-meter run.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned wanting to start at a relaxed intensity.
In that case... maybe around an 18-second per furlong pace?
choice_data_list: No, I'd like to start at 20 seconds per furlong first.
No, I'd like to start at 20 seconds per furlong first.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's pretty gentle...! The woodchip
track is already soft on my legs as it is—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, are you super worried about me?
I'm fine, you know? My body's grown a lot stronger since back then.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I know. But even so—
Yeah, I know. But even so—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I see. The outer perimeter track I talked about running on
before had that many hard patches of ground?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: And since I went running yesterday too... the stress on my bones has probably built up. So we're prioritizing the high-cushion woodchip track—
choice_data_list: Don't worry, we'll gradually ramp up the load.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
......Understood!
Loud and clear, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah... phew!
16-second pace, done...! Phew...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(For a moment... I thought you were still just
acting like my kind, sweet "big bro.")

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(For a moment... I thought you were still just
acting like my kind, sweet "big sis.")

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (But that's not it. You've become a real Trainer now.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (...You became one, just like this, for my sake.)
choice_data_list: Alright, break's over! Last stretch, 15-second pace!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—And that covers the plan leading up to race day.
I'll give it my all starting tomorrow, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So... does that wrap up everything on our meeting's agenda?
If you'd like, want to take a breather together? I'll brew some tea.
choice_data_list: Ah, actually... there's just one more thing before that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hmm?
choice_data_list: About the breathtaking sight you're striving for—
About the breathtaking sight you're striving for—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "What kind of breathtaking sight I want to reach," huh...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's true that Spe-san's Japan Cup was what sparked my admiration,
but I'm not her. I can't create that exact same scenery.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I have my own view that I want to reach!
Even if it isn't completely concrete just yet.
choice_data_list: I see. And... what kind of view is it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "A breathtaking sight that reaches everyone," I think.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the feelings and dreams of as many people as possible on my back.
Reaching it together with as many people as I can—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A powerful, dazzling, glorious scene of victory.
That's the dream I'm striving for.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to run in a way that touches everyone's hearts.
One look, and they're captivated, wanting nothing more than to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a horsegirl... who can ignite
such intense, powerful hope in everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
......Ehehe. Is that a little bold coming from someone who hasn't even debuted yet?
You've got that look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Even so, I believe in it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I believe that someday, without fail, I'll reach that dream.
I truly believe it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I don't think I've ever doubted this feeling... not even once.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Ah... there it is again.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Your expression just stiffened.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Well then!
Can we say the meeting is officially over this time?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's take that breather together.
...I'll go brew us some warm tea.
